name: A Badger's Nights
source:
We'll travel back in time, much further than you might imagine...

Before the events of [url=/v28983]The Smoke Room[/url], we'll learn how Nik arrived in America, on a journey fraught with obstacles and misfortunes, where loneliness and survival are daily realities.

[From [url=https://ducksanity1.itch.io/a-badgers-night]Itch.io[/url]]
